frozen_contract.coordinate_convention: MediaPipe normalized x/y in [0,1]; z dropped; canonical [Left, Right] slots
frozen_contract.missing_hand_policy: explicit per-hand presence flags; absent hand is zeros plus flag; inter-hand features zero when either hand absent
frozen_contract.sampling: read_frames samples 32 frames evenly across the whole clip, resized 256x256 RGB; build_features linearly resamples to 24

calibration_code_audit.exporter_representative_set: X[:300] from .scratch/landmarks/val after build_features(expected_frames=frames); entry skips clips whose max present < 0.5; this is the official val split, not training
calibration_code_audit.exporter_accuracy_gate: drop = 0.0 is hardcoded, so the stated >15pp rejection condition is unreachable
calibration_code_audit.exporter_accuracy_populations: int8_acc is computed over all X, while pt_acc is computed over the first 200 rows; the two values are not paired
calibration_code_audit.exporter_calibration_ordering: files are sorted by path, then truncated to 300; no per-signer, per-gloss, hand-coverage stratification or shuffling
calibration_code_audit.exporter_input_quantization_note: the converter sets float32 input/output, so the interpreter applies an internal QUANTIZE; src/main.py's external q_tensor branch is unused for this artifact
calibration_code_audit.missing_hand_coverage: clips with zero hand frames are skipped from calibration; partially missing-hand clips are included only if their maximum presence exceeds 0.5
calibration_code_audit.no_calibration_artifact_in_checkout: the checkpoint, calibration tensor list, and alternate INT8 candidate are absent; the shipped INT8 bytes cannot be reproduced or replaced here
calibration_code_audit.second_exporter_exists: scripts/ml/export_int8.py exists on origin/hackathon/dev-model and writes the same output path via onnxruntime static quantization (per-channel QDQ, calib.pt or synthetic fallback); both exporters target models/landmark_classifier_int8.tflite, so provenance must be stated explicitly
calibration_code_audit.meta_discrepancy: the shipped landmark_model_meta.json contains quantization:'float16' and lacks val_top1_int8/size_kb, matching neither export_tflite_tf.py nor export_int8.py output; treat the shipped meta as hand-augmented until Dev confirms provenance
